original_title: The mind that disappears every third camera frame

original_title: A perfectly still mechanism and a genuinely clamped one
current_explanation: One stationary passive trajectory does not identify the controlled law.
limit: A stipulated intervention differs from an actually grounded intervention.

original_title: A continually renewed world with no memory of the opening instant
current_explanation: Forgetting an initial seed differs from retaining an ongoing input stream.
limit: Does not determine personal continuation or all complete organization.

original_title: Two large systems connected by an arbitrarily rare update
current_explanation: Rare coupling can have a small finite-horizon distributional effect.
limit: No discontinuous subject-merger threshold follows; historical bound not newly derived.

original_title: Millions of names, one execution; two executions, one program
current_explanation: Software labels, structural types and actual executions are different counts.

original_title: Artificially noisy decorations on a small controller

original_title: The physically rebuilt encoder

original_title: A short program emulating an enormous organization

limit: A short description alone does not actualize all described alternatives.

original_title: An isolated dream with its sensory cables removed

limit: Dream phenomenology is stipulated, not derived for an arbitrary circuit.

original_title: A steady featureless experience

limit: No claim that a one-bit model captures full experience.

original_title: Memory erased but the current process continues

limit: Erasure may change organization; do not assume complete type unchanged.

original_title: A perfect language performance outside the candidate mechanism

original_title: Reverse the reward labels without changing the mechanism

original_title: Three returning routes, none individually indispensable
current_explanation: Redundant causal use can be invisible to every baseline singleton replacement.

original_title: Many minimal witnesses, not many subjects
current_explanation: Many overlapping minimal causal witnesses are not thereby many subjects.

original_title: A genuinely unused route remains unused collectively
current_explanation: Collective replacement does not create use in a mechanism ignoring all return routes.

original_title: Two changes cancel

limit: Do not infer monotonicity or complete response from minimal-witness lists.

original_title: A protected distinction with diminishing single-carrier sensitivity

original_title: One corrupted cable feeding every replica

original_title: Near-perfect retention is not infinite survival

original_title: More reliable content is not more kinds of content
